question: My car was stolen with the keys in it while I paid for fuel inside. Am I covered?
expected_answer: Refer to handler. Clause 7.6 excludes theft with keys in an unattended car, with an exception for force or threat; facts decide.
retrieved_clauses: 7.6, 4.3, 6.3, Table 3: Stolen keys, Table 3: Lost keys, 1.7
search_text: theft of vehicle with keys left inside; theft cover; keys left in vehicle exclusion; unattended vehicle clause
answer: a) What the wording says: - [7.6] We do not pay for theft of your car if the keys were left in it while unattended, except where the keys were taken from you by force or threat. - [4.3] We do not pay for theft or attempted theft if the keys were left in the car or in a place where the car could be started without them, see clause 7.6. - [1.7] Unattended means no driver or authorised person is in or beside the car.  b) Facts a handler must confirm: - Were the keys left in the car while it was unattended? - Was the policyholder or an authorised person in or beside the car at the time? - Were the keys taken from the policyholder by force or threat?  Please refer this case to a claims handler.
